summary: Stock Yards Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of Field Main Bancorp, Inc. and its subsidiary bank, Field Main Bank, Inc. (collectively Field Main). The filing confirms the appointment of Scott P. Davis, Field Main's CEO, to the Board effective May 1, 2026, as previously announced. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 highlights the merger completion. No financial terms (price per share, premium, consideration) or advisors are disclosed in this excerpt. The acquisition appears to be a strategic bolt-on for Stock Yards Bancorp. Watch for integration updates and potential synergies in future filings; risk-arb is moot as deal closed.
